definitions.explanation: The natural features of an area that can be seen, especially when considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風景|ふうけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧{風景|ふうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a photo of the scenery visible from the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風景|ふうけい}{画|が}→風景画：28196_fuukeiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧です。
examples.notes: ⟦{風景|ふうけい}{画|が}→風景画：28196_fuukeiga⟧ = landscape painting

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧{風景|ふうけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I like how the scenery seen from the train window changes with each season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧{風景|ふうけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{美|うつく}しくて→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{立|た}ち{止|と}まって→立ち止まる：04636_tachidomaru⟧⟦{眺|なが}めて→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The scenery I encountered at my travel destination was so beautiful that I stood still for a while and gazed at it.

notes:
USAGE: {風景|ふうけい} typically refers to natural scenery or landscapes, often with an aesthetic connotation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {風景|ふうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧ (to gaze at the scenery)
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}{画|が}→風景画：28196_fuukeiga⟧ (landscape painting)
- {風景|ふうけい}⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (landscape photography)
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{風景|ふうけい} (beautiful scenery)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧ - scenery (more general, can include urban views)
- ⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧ - view (what one sees from a particular spot)
- ⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧ - scene (often dramatic or memorable)
